newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Central Union High School, Calif..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Central Union High School, Calif..

text.p: NOTICE OF INTENTION TO SELL BONDS
General Obligation Bonds, 1993 Election, Series B
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN, pursuant to California Government Code Section 53692, that the Board of Trustees of the Central Union High School District, Imperial County,
California, intends to sell $5,150,000 principal amount of Central Union High School District General Obligation Bonds, 1993 Election, Series B. Bids will be received on

at 10:00 a.m., at the offices of Andrew Ach & Associates, Inc., One Post Street, Suite 2525, San Francisco, CA 94104, phone (415) 546-6460 or by facsimile at (415) 546-7875, and the sale will be awarded by the Superintendent of the Central Union High School District or his designee on behalf of the Board of Trustees of the Central Union High School District within twenty-six (26) hours after the bid opening is completed. In the event that the Superintendent or his authorized designee does not award a bid on the date specified above, proposals will be received the following Tuesday at the same time as a bid is awarded or notice to the contrary is given. Further information, including copies of the Preliminary Official Statement, Official Notice of Sale and Bid Form, may be obtained from the Financial Advisor at the above address.
Legal Opinion: Bowie, Arneson, Kadi, Wiles & Giannone, Newport Beach, California
